vectors.notes: Wrapped in RUN_STARTED/RUN_FINISHED (the TS test feeds the reducer bare events). updates[0] of the TS test; asserted with toEqual (full objects). Any present @ag-ui/client declaration that does not name 'foreign' grants no deletion of it.
vectors.specConflict: The snapshot carries activity messages, so state.mdx says the omitted activity 'omitted' is dropped ([same, new]); the reference keeps it because the snapshot's metadata carries an @ag-ui/client declaration (even an invalid one).
